name: Focused Critical (Akashic)
body:
You can focus your spirit into your weapon attacks, dealing more damage with successful critical strikes.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13.

Benefit(s): You can invest essence into this feat. You gain an insight bonus equal to the invested essence on attack rolls made to confirm a critical threat. You also gain an insight bonus equal to the invested essence on damage rolls made as part of a critical hit. (This extra damage is also multiplied for the critical hit.)

You gain 1 point of essence.
